text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio displays an overwhelming run. 
However, Ikuno Dictus's experience proves 
superior.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus had continuously fought 
against Umamusume who exceeded their 
limits. Using that experience, she 
conquered the fiercely contested Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Ikuno Dictus and Tokai Teio— everyone 
was able to finish the race safe and 
sound.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching them, the spectators wished for a 
future where Umamusume could continue 
running for a long time while giving it 
their all—
